# Copilot instructions for OpenNutriTracker

Purpose
- Short guide for Copilot-style assistants to help contributors quickly find build/test commands, architecture, and repo conventions.

Build / test / lint commands
- All commands are orchestrated via the justfile (see `justfile`). Key targets:
  - just install       -> flutter pub get
  - just build         -> dart run build_runner build
  - just format [opts] -> dart format ./lib/core ./lib/features ./lib/l10n ./test
  - just test          -> flutter test
  - just check_intl    -> verify generated intl files (used in CI)
  - just ci            -> install, intl check, build, analyze, test (CI preflight)
- Single test file example:
  - flutter test test/unit_test/tdee_calc_test.dart
- Static analysis:
  - flutter analyze
- Notes:
  - A local .env (copy from .env.example if present) is required to generate env.g.dart via `just build` (env.g.dart is gitignored).
  - `just format` deliberately excludes lib/generated/ — do not format generated intl files.

High-level architecture (big picture)
- Clean Architecture, feature-based layout. Top-level: lib/core + lib/features.
  - Each feature uses three layers: data (DTOs, datasources), domain (Entity, Usecase), presentation (Bloc + widgets).
- State management: flutter_bloc (each screen has Bloc/Event/State files).
- Dependency injection: GetIt; registrations happen in lib/core/utils/locator.dart (order matters: data sources → repositories → use cases → blocs).
- Local DB: hive_ce with AES encryption. Five main boxes: ConfigBox, IntakeBox, UserActivityBox, UserBox, TrackedDayBox. Hive adapters are generated for DBOs; lib/hive_registrar.g.dart aggregates registrations.
- App startup: main() → initLocator() → Hive DB init (AES key from flutter_secure_storage) → Supabase init → check user data → route to onboarding or main.
- Product search: ProductsRepository aggregates OpenFoodFacts, Supabase FDC, and USDA FDC (Supabase is used for text search in the UI).

Key repo conventions (non-obvious)
- Naming suffixes used consistently:
  - DBO: Hive database objects (lib/core/data/dbo/)
  - DTO: API response models
  - Entity: domain models
  - Bloc / Event / State: UI state management files
  - Usecase, Repository, DataSource: single-responsibility classes
- Generated files policy:
  - Build runner generates *.g.dart for Hive adapters and json_serializable DTOs. Run `just build` after changing annotated files.
  - lib/core/utils/env.g.dart is generated from .env and is gitignored — regenerate locally after cloning with a real .env.
  - lib/generated/ (intl) files are maintained manually in this repo due to formatting constraints. Do not run intl generators that would overwrite these files unless the project is updated to accept the generator output.
- Hive DBO typeIds:
  - When adding @HiveType, assign a unique typeId and verify no collisions across the repo.
  - Regenerate lib/hive_registrar.g.dart if DBO types are added/removed.
- Formatting / style:
  - 120-character line width (analysis_options.yaml).
  - `just format` targets a subset of files (lib/core, lib/features, lib/l10n, test). Do not run dart format on lib/generated/.
- Localization workflow:
  - Add new keys to every ARB under lib/l10n/ and update lib/generated/l10n.dart + messages_<locale>.dart entries as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
  - Run `just check_intl` to validate the PR (CI gate).
- Branching / PRs:
  - All PRs must target develop (main is reserved for release merges).
- CI notes (useful when editing workflows):
  - GitHub Actions set up for linux, macOS (iOS), and Android builds. CI generates a stub .env so tests run without secrets; local builds require a real .env.
  - The repo includes scripts to safely handle iOS Podfile lock drift (.github/scripts/pod_install_with_targeted_fallback.sh) and a unit test for that parser.

Where to look first (useful files)
- justfile — canonical build/test commands
- CLAUDE.md — a detailed companion doc containing architecture and generation notes (copy important rules from here)
- CONTRIBUTING.md — PR/intl/localization rules and branch policy
- lib/core/utils/locator.dart — DI registration order
- lib/core/utils/hive_db_provider.dart and lib/hive_registrar.g.dart — Hive registration and opened boxes

Other AI assistant configs
- CLAUDE.md exists and contains authoritative operational notes (FVM flutter version, code generation triggers, localization caveats). No other AI assistant config files found.

If modifying or generating files
- Run `just build` after changing @HiveType / @HiveField / @JsonSerializable files.
- Run `just check_intl` after touching i18n strings and maintain lib/generated/ per the repo conventions.

Contact / context
